nodes.label: Index Class (Staging Area)
nodes.rationale: Index stored as text (<mode> <hash> <filename>) so it is human-readable for debugging.

nodes.label: Logger Class
nodes.rationale: Logger included to make issues easy to trace.

nodes.label: .arkignore Exact Path Matching
nodes.rationale: Currently supports exact path matching only, not glob/regex.

nodes.label: Ark (Git-like VCS in C++)
nodes.rationale: Minimal Git-like version control system built to understand how Git works under the hood.

nodes.label: Content-Addressable Storage
nodes.rationale: Objects stored and retrieved by SHA-256 hash; ensures unique identification and deduplication.

nodes.label: Exception-based Error Handling
nodes.rationale: Custom exception hierarchy gives clean error propagation.

nodes.label: Object Model (Blob, Tree, Commit)
nodes.rationale: Object format kept similar to Git (<type> <size>\0<data>) for interoperability and to demonstrate how Git works internally.

nodes.label: SHA-256 Hashing
nodes.rationale: Chosen for content-addressing: unique identification and deduplication of objects (64 hex char ids).

nodes.label: zlib Compression
nodes.rationale: Reduces storage space for stored objects.
